mapper.insert: insert into pet (name, cat_age, cat_status, cat_img, cat_info) values (#{inputName}, #{inputAge}, #{inputStatus}, #{inputCatImg}, #{inputCatInfo})
mapper.select: select count(*) from pet where id = #{catId}
mapper.update: update pet set name = #{inputName}, cat_age = #{inputAge}, cat_status = #{inputStatus}, cat_img = #{inputCatImg}, cat_info = #{inputCatInfo} where id = #{inputId}
mapper.delete: delete from pet where id in #{id}
